title: Retrospect
summary: RET'ROSPECT, noun [Latin retro, back, and specio, to look.] A looking back on things past; view or contemplation of something past. The retrospect of a life well spent affords peace of mind in old age

inlines.v: RET'ROSPECT, noun [Latin retro, back, and specio, to look.] A looking back on things past; view or contemplation of something past. The retrospect of a life well spent affords peace of mind in old age.
